question: The normal term of every Lok Sabha ______ is years
solution:
The correct answer is **__5.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Lok Sabha is the lower house of India's bicameral Parliament.
 
• The Hindi name of Lok Sabha was adopted by the house of the people on 14th May 1954.
 
• **The full term of a Lok Sabha is 5 years.**
